CORE MATHEMATICS — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #14
====

GRADE: Grade 11
SUBJECT: CORE MATHEMATICS
TIME ALLOWED: 45 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 30
EXAM BODY: KNEC / KCSE pathway

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. A square plot has side 12 m. What is its area in m²? (1 mark)
   A. 24
   B. 156
   C. 48
   D. 144

2. In the number 3143, what is the place value of digit 4? (1 mark)
   A. 400
   B. 4
   C. 10
   D. 40

3. A square plot has side 6 m. What is its area in m²? (1 mark)
   A. 42
   B. 12
   C. 24
   D. 36

4. What is 8 × 9? (1 mark)
   A. 73
   B. 1
   C. 72
   D. 17

5. Solve for x: x + 9 = 20. (1 mark)
   A. 9
   B. 12
   C. 20
   D. 11

6. In a right-angled triangle, the two shorter sides are 9 cm and 40 cm. Find the hypotenuse. (1 mark)
   A. 41
   B. 31
   C. 49
   D. 43

7. What is 4 × 6? (1 mark)
   A. 10
   B. 24
   C. 25
   D. 2

8. What is the square of 5? (1 mark)
   A. 26
   B. 25
   C. 10
   D. 5

9. A square plot has side 9 m. What is its area in m²? (1 mark)
   A. 90
   B. 18
   C. 36
   D. 81

10. What is 4 × 3? (1 mark)
   A. 13
   B. 12
   C. 1
   D. 7

11. In the number 3543, what is the place value of digit 4? (1 mark)
   A. 400
   B. 10
   C. 40
   D. 4

12. What is 8 × 4? (1 mark)
   A. 32
   B. 12
   C. 4
   D. 33

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
13. Show full working: A trader sells 14 items at Ksh 50 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

14. Show full working: A trader sells 15 items at Ksh 55 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

15. Show full working: A trader sells 16 items at Ksh 60 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

16. Show full working: A trader sells 17 items at Ksh 65 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)
